items.title: Runner plan: one runner per two cores, allocated by measured demand
items.brief: scripts/mini/runner-plan.sh plans the mini's runners (9 on its 18 cores), at least one per scope that ran a job in 14 days and never fewer than 4 for runsheet; add-runner.sh and remove-runner.sh change them. ADR 029.
items.acceptance: `bash scripts/mini/runner-plan_test.sh` passes; scripts/mini/runner-plan.sh prints the plan without applying it; docs/adr/029 describes the allocation.
items.model_reason: one script with tests to copy

items.title: Mini load: the self-hosted runners keep the host's load down
items.brief: With the runner plan applied and e2e sharded, the mini's load settles.
items.acceptance: the mini's load p90 under 1.5 × cores over a day, read from the Hosts panel.

items.title: Shard the e2e suite in three
items.brief: Cut the e2e suite into three shards by measured duration; each shard a job of the e2e workflow; a -check tool proves the lists disjoint and complete.
items.acceptance: `go test ./tools/shardplan/...` passes; the three shards' durations within 20% of each other in a sequential run on the mini, recorded in the README.
